name: Settlement Method 7 Choice
definition: Settlement details to determine whether payment is a credit or debit.

Credit.name: Credit
Credit.definition: Specifies details of the payment to be made by the old account servicer to the new account servicer in case of a positive closing balance.

Debit.name: Debit
Debit.definition: Specifies details of the payment to be made by the new account servicer to the old account servicer in case of a negative closing balance.
